reviews.rationale: Article: rebuilding began 1675 and finished 1683. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: rebuilt, incorporating some old walls, between 1676 and 1686. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: mason's contract signed 2 August 1670; body completed by 1673; tower took a further seven years to 1680. Seed/listing 1670-83 kept as whole-church alternative.
Article: new church begun 1675 and completed four years later. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: building commenced 1682 and the church was complete by 1685. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: rebuilt between 1677 and 1683. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: rebuilding began 1670; building of the church and steeple completed 1675. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: rebuilding commenced 1671 and finished 1676. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: work carried forward 1671-1687, the body substantially complete by 1676; listing gives 1671-87 with steeple 1705. Body interval verified; whole-programme range kept as alternative.
Article: rebuilt in 1678-84. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: building began 1683 and was completed 1687. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: reconstruction began 1681 and the body was complete by 1684; steeple completed 14 years later by Hawksmoor. Seed 1681-98 kept as whole-church alternative.
Article and Historic England listing agree: main part rebuilt 1670-73; tower 1695-98 (listing: 1697); spire 1709-12. Resolves the dispute as a scope difference.
reviews.caveat: Body only; tower and spire later.

reviews.rationale: Article: rebuilding began 1681; 1686 accounts record the opening; spire work continued into the following year. End year is the opening.
reviews.caveat: End is the opening; spire continued to 1687.

reviews.rationale: Article: rebuilt between 1677 and 1684. Encyclopedia source; matches seed list.
Article: church and tower (without steeple) completed 1687, steeple 1704. Listing and seed give 1677-91. End years conflict; start not stated by the article.
Article: completed 1685. Seed and the tower listing give 1682-87. End years conflict.
Article: new church completed 1676. Seed gives 1670-77.
Article: rebuilt between 1672 and 1678. Listing and seed give 1671-81.
Article: built anew between 1670 and 1677. Listing and seed give 1670-86; scope of the later end not stated.
Article: rebuilding began 1671, completed 1679. Listing and seed give 1670-79.
Article: work on the exterior was completed in 1677; gallery and vault funded 1691.
Article: rebuilt to Wren's design in 1678. Single year; scope and start not stated.
Article: rebuilt by Wren in 1687. Single year; scope and start not stated.
Article: rebuilt by Wren in 1673 (citation flagged incomplete in the article).
Article: rebuilt in 1674; tower added ten years later.
Article: new building completed 1694.
Article: redesigned by Wren and reopened in 1683.
Article: new church opened September 1683; steeple not finished until 1695.
Article 1686-1690 versus listing 1686-95; neither separates the tower.
Article starts 1685 (paused 1688-89), listing starts 1686; both end 1694.
Article gives 1677-1684 and, elsewhere, 'largely completed by 1680, finished in 1703'; listing gives 1677-87.
Article 1677-1684 is flagged 'citation needed'; listing gives 1677 to 87.
Quoted inscription: foundations 1676, reopened 1682, finished 1683; listing gives 1674-87. Start years differ.
Article 1681-1686 versus listing and infobox 1681-87.
Article gives only 1687; listing gives 1684 to 89.
